569-1770-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
569-1770-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Mist Raven by paying its mana cost.
When Mist Raven enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2577-5686-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5686-6664-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

277-851-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

851-1308-4772-5478-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-1308-4772-5478-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

1172-7440.description:
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate the ability granted by Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 as desired.
Cast Crackle with Power by paying {R}{R} and all remaining available mana, dealing a large amount of damage to a set number of targets.
1172-7440.notes: The more life you have, the more damage you will deal, and you'll also get more targets to deal damage to. You can also add mana as desired from other sources to cast Crackle with Power.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-5662-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1621-2146-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-3499-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-4871-7057-7147-7654.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Sundering Archaic by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Nightscape Familiar.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1563-3899-4365-5434.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

4090-7637.description:
Any damage that would be dealt to you is redirected to Cho-Manno due to Pariah.
Because of Cho-Manno's effect, no damage will be dealt to it either, preventing the damage entirely.

4499-7445-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

6867-6884-7444.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1458-1739-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-1739-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Herald's Horn.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

413-4986-5463--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Nurturing Pixie from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nurturing Pixie enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Nurturing Pixie trigger, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Nurturing Pixie
Repeat.
413-4986-5463--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

3817-4605-5231-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

791-1605-3693-7186.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-1605-3693-7186.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

582-1409-3129.description:
Activate Brazen Freebooter by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Brazen Freebooter enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Brazen Freebooter.
Resolve the Brazen Freebooter trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

11-2575-5864-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2575-5864-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Mastery by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Mastery.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Mastery spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Mastery and returning the original Temporal Mastery to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Mastery from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

30-141-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-141-6798.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-141-6798.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

3532-3581-5078-6769.easyPrerequisites: There are at least two counters on creatures you control.
3532-3581-5078-6769.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Surge Conductor triggers, putting a counter on a creature you control that already has a counter on it.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

511-560-817-3921-4050.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Soldier and Saproling, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2324-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2324-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain life equal to the persist creature's toughness.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

3020-5231-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
3020-5231-6701.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Puppeteer Clique enters, it triggers, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control.
Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Repeat.

338-5641-5789.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-5641-5789.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

650-2034-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
650-2034-6553.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

141-6106.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Electroduplicate
141-6106.description:
Cast Electroduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Electroduplicate, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Electroduplicate, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

413-2459-5220-5683.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Rograkh from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Rograkh and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

4186-4304-5929.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying {2}{G}.
When Scurry Oak enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Leyline of Transformation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Leyline of Transformation, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-3908--39.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-3908--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Spark Double trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

186-1247-4289.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
186-1247-4289.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Heartstone and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2534-4702.easyPrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Coercive Recruiter.
2534-4702.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the nontoken Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

1526-3263-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Circle of Dreams Druid.
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one other creature.
1526-3263-3525.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it to add at least {G}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {G} to untap Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.
